from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional

class CompanyFinancials(BaseModel):
    """Financial data extracted from a single company's Q1 2025 report."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="The name of the company in the report")
    stock_code: Optional[str] = Field(description="The stock/securities code of the company")
    period: str = Field(description="The reporting period, expected to be '2025 Q1'")
    
    # Core financial figures needed for ratio calculations
    operating_revenue: float = Field(description="Operating Revenue for the period")
    ending_accounts_receivable: float = Field(description="Ending Accounts Receivable")
    total_operating_cost: float = Field(description="Total Operating Cost")
    ending_inventory: float = Field(description="Ending Inventory")
    weighted_average_roe: float = Field(description="Weighted Average Return on Equity")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[CompanyFinancials] = Field(description="List of companies extracted from the provided document collection")
